LABEL_WIND (scripts/implied_wind.py): Weather-implied generation. What the weather says these plants should produce, from open-source models (windpowerlib) and public plant data. Not a forecast of metered output and not any plant's schedule.
CURVE_DATA_NOTICE (implied_gen/wind_meth: Contains information from the Wind Turbine Library (OpenEnergy Platform, supply.wind_turbine_library, (c) Reiner Lemoine Institut), which is made available under the Open Database License (ODbL-1.0): https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
CAISO_ISSUE_SENTENCE (implied_gen/wind_m: CAISO's day-ahead forecast: issued between 06:09 PT the day before and 06:09 PT on the day (as far as we know).
